objective: Test whether a real, public microbiome survival cohort supplies an independent frozen prior that can improve V7 without using generator-only information.

feature_sets: tissue-specific five-genus CLR plus log panel load

source_mbr_distillation_screen.purpose: Transfer only information recoverable from the five genera observed by V7; do not fabricate the other genera.
feature_sets: tissue-specific five-genus CLR plus log panel load

v7_development_gate_if_source_passes.baseline: V9 locked core_no_edges XGBoost Cox stump_l10
candidate_methods: add frozen AC-ICAM PFS prior as one model feature
validation-calibrated positive residual with alpha grid 0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.4, 0.8, 1.2
v7_development_gate_if_source_passes.source_tissue_mapping: adjacent normal colon model applied to V7 stool five-genus panel

formal_policy: Do not access the formal V7 cohort unless both source and V7 development gates pass. Formal evaluation is one-time and uses seeds 7, 21, 42, 123, and 2026.
